why: Item 5 mixes thanking allies with celebrating the finished design, so the two gates compete.

why.T3-001: Members staged a false season-three announcement and teaser as an April Fools fake and later revealed it.
why.T3-032: Several replies object to the prank as hurtful or too far, not merely playing inside it.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-001 carries staging and revealing the fake but does not carry the objection that the joke was hurtful or too far.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: T3-032's gate is satisfied by concepts objecting to the prank as hurtful or excessive.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-032 if forced, losing the record of members objecting to the April Fools prank

why.T3-005: An attack on Megumin is named and members call to fight, protect, and not give up, rather than only watching and repairing.

why.T3-188: The room separates allies and their leaders from random griefers and disguised Void provocateurs, disowning rogue placers to preserve peace.

why.T3-016: Members ask what r/place is for and answer by explaining the event as a fun April Fools joke.

why.T3-072: The passages thank the Blues fans and mark the new friendship more than they celebrate the room's own finished work.
why.T3-009: The final Megumin design is shown and praised as achieved, which T3-072 does not carry.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-072 carries thanking the Blues allies but not the retrospective praise of the completed Megumin design.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: T3-009's gate is satisfied by showing the final design and calling it beautiful and amazing.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-009 if forced, losing the celebration of the final design

why.T3-082: Members find Megumin already placed, ask who coordinated it, and claim or thank the making.
why.T3-070: The passages also circulate the original plan, chart, and reference image for others to follow.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-082 carries finding the existing Megumin and asking who made it but not circulating the plan, chart, and reference for placement.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: T3-070's gate is satisfied by links to the original plan, the reference image, and following the chart.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-070 if forced, losing the plan and reference circulation

why.T3-001: The room's own April Fools post is revealed as a prank and readers report being fooled and acknowledging it.

why.T3-033: A new artwork is proposed and the room is called to make the mockup real, with only minor design objections.

why.T3-004: The passages settle and correct the shared Scott picture's details, from shading and eye placement to following the reference, rather than enforcing one template.

why.T3-033: The item proposes putting a diamond bracket mark on r/place and calls the room to make it, with coordinates and help following the proposal.

why.T3-002: The item is built around calls to come help place Scott, with individual commitments and redirected effort, rather than sharing a template as the main act.

why.T3-006: Members call and plan to blow up or shrink the German flag and ask whether to attack the Blues, making an attack on rivals the point.

why.T3-073: The single concept recounts what happened to the DiamondClub work when placement ended, reporting that the diamond was just about down.

why.T3-004: The passages settle and correct the shared Scott picture's details, from shading and eye placement to following the reference, rather than enforcing one template.

why.T3-021: The passages center on maintaining and repairing the existing Megumin, recruiting an overnight maintenance team and fixing what Germany destroys.
why.T3-038: They also keep placing pixels and directing the build, such as adding the brown pixel and flooding the laser side blue.
why.T3-004: They revise the design of the existing mark, making the staff brown, proposing a border, and explaining a new face as redesign.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-021 carries repair and maintenance but not the ongoing pixel placement and building work.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: T3-038's gate is satisfied by adding the brown pixel, urging continued building, directing the laser side, and committing pixels.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-038 if forced, losing the record of ongoing building and placement

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-021 and T3-038 do not carry the redesign decisions about the mark's look, such as the staff colour, border, or new face.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: T3-004's gate is satisfied by concepts settling and correcting the design of the existing Megumin.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-004 if forced, losing the redesign of the face and staff
